name: Ledge
description: A dot-matrix strip in the top bar for people who code with AI agents. See every running agent at a glance, which ones are working or waiting on you, and jump to the one that needs you with Super+Shift+N. Also shows Claude Code and Codex usage limits with pace and spend, plus power, todos, GitHub and training runs. Reads your existing tool sign-ins and local session files only; no telemetry, no message text.
